integrity: Every one of 85823 canonical representatives over 1<=n<=6 is enumerated by two methods and its level independently compared by two tests. Source cardinality sequence provides a separate check, not a proof of general correctness. This result is not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive finite census only for 1<=n<=6; known normal-form theorem assumed. No assertion of all-n palindromicity, formula, pairwise metric distance distribution, or independent priority certification.
title: Complete radial census through six generators for the Kiselman ultrametric
